# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2006

**Appropriation Ordinance No. 01**

## Summary

An appropriation ordinance enacting the Pre-Closing Special Budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2005. At the close of business on December 31, 2005 (note: document states "2006" but context indicates FY 2005), there was a savings of P 458,592.22 and an overdraft in appropriation in the same amount. The ordinance appropriates funds to cover the overdraft and make expenditures proper and legal for the year 2005.

**Total savings at close of business (Dec 31, 2005):** P 458,592.22
**Total overdraft in appropriation:** P 458,592.22

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** At the close of business on December 31, 2006 [sic, covering FY 2005], there is a savings of Four Hundred Fifty Eight Thousand Five Hundred Ninety Two Pesos and Twenty Two Centavos (P 458,592.22) and an overdraft in appropriation in the amount of Four Hundred Fifty Eight Thousand Five Hundred Ninety Two Pesos and Twenty Two Centavos (P 458,592.22).
- **Section 2.** The amount of P 458,592.22 is hereby appropriated to cover up overdraft in appropriation in the amount of P 458,592.22 to make it proper and legal the expenditures for the year 2005.
- **Section 3.** The Pre-Closing Special Budget prepared by the Municipal Budget Officer is hereby attached and made as integral part of this ordinance marked as "Annex A".
